name: Writing
overview: Scripture highlights writing as a powerful means of preserving truth and establishing authority, as seen when Esther commands letters to be written and sealed by the king to ensure their irrevocability. The psalmist describes writing as the expression of heartfelt instruction and praise, likening the tongue to the pen of a ready writer. Wisdom literature encourages writing God's truth upon the heart, symbolizing internal commitment to mercy and truth, while committing works to the Lord leads to established thoughts. Additionally, the role of scribes as copyists underscores the importance of accurate transmission of God's word and commands.
